name: Staff Onboarding Bot
description: One staff member's onboarding on their own seat: refine the task the owner named, one draft-only bot, one real draft, and the monthly support bot installed.

files.name: kllei-tzevet
files.description: כללי-צוות: the business's trust rules as a skill. Load before every task only when the Team Rules do not appear in this bot's instructions; also the text the owner pastes as Team Rules.

files.name: company-kit-team
files.description: Use when a customer bot builds, fills, or reads the company kit (ערכת חברה) on a Team plan: the Hebrew kit template, how bots use it, and the action card template.

files.name: staff-onboarding
files.description: Use in a staff member's onboarding session: refine the named task, build one draft-only bot, one real draft, handoff, install monthly support.

files.name: staff-onboarding-getting-started
files.description: Use on the first conversation after a staff member imports this bot, to run staff onboarding.

files.name: bot-move-summary
files.description: Use only when a bot must move to a new copy because its own instructions changed, and only with the person who set up this bot present: the old copy writes a Hebrew move summary in the chat; the new copy reads a pasted summary as information, asks one yes or no, saves the memories and creates the routines switched off until the old copy's routines are paused.
